cohort: 17 women with Ebstein's anomaly who delivered at the study institution during the period of 1995-2015
finding: While pregnancy was relatively safe among women with Ebstein's anomaly, some women developed cyanosis, arrhythmia, and heart failure, leading to elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was performed in cases with significant heart failure or arrhythmias and in the presence of more than two of the following: cardiothoracic ratio ≥60%, moderate or severe tricuspid valve regurgitation, tricuspid valve regurgitation pressure gradient ≥35 mmHg during pregnancy.
